name: Marve
summary: Marve features a dark grey elm veneered top with a solid wood edge that gives the surface a tailored, well crafted presence. The fiberglass base is wrapped in matching dark grey elm veneer, creating a continuous, sculptural form with a refined modern tone. The piece carries a quiet sophistication built on texture, craftsmanship and cohesive design. Top MDF covered with elm veneer dark grey, solid wood edge, fiber glass base with elm veneer dark grey 80x73x49.5
